title: Design Food Delivery (Swiggy / Zomato)
relevance: High — hard multi-actor LLD / machine-coding staple (campus + SDE-2); Swiggy, Zomato, Flipkart, Uber, Amazon, Dunzo-style loops probe order FSM + delivery assignment + notifications; pairs with HLD ride-hailing / geo matching (hq06) and notification LLD (lq12).
company_notes: Campus/machine-coding staple at Swiggy, Zomato, Flipkart, Uber, Amazon new-grad and Indian product cos — working order FSM + nearest assign + clean classes beat a pattern zoo; concurrency/notifications are stretch after happy path. SDE-2 expects valid transitions, atomic agent assign, Observer decoupling, Strategy for search/assign, and may bridge to HLD (Redis GEO, dispatch queues, dinner-peak scaling). FAANG-adjacent OOD (DoorDash-like / Meta/Amazon tags) focuses on multi-actor flows + class model. Among the top hard LLD problems with Movie Booking, Ride Sharing, and Splitwise — canonical multi-party workflow + Strategy matching + Observer after Parking Lot / Elevator.

phases.goal: Lock marketplace scope, FRs, cancel/assign/payment rules, and NFRs before any class sketch.

must_hit.point: Clarify marketplace vs single restaurant, auto-assign timing (on place vs on ready), cancel rules, payment in/out of scope, and one restaurant per order (cart across restaurants usually no).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Candidate asks clarifying questions and states assumptions like one city demo, in-memory OK, payment mocked, assign on READY_FOR_PICKUP, cancel only from PENDING.

must_hit.point: Cover typical FRs: register customers/restaurants/agents; menu manage; search + view menu; place order; restaurant prep status; assign agent; track to delivered; cancel early; notify on status change.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Lists the FR checklist without diving into surge, ETA ML, or dark stores unless asked.

must_hit.point: Call out use cases: happy path browse→deliver; two orders race one agent; cancel while PENDING; no agents → stay ready/retry; menu unavailable mid-browse fails at place.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Walks through those scenarios as acceptance checks before design.

must_hit.point: State NFRs: thread-safe concurrent orders; extensible assignment/search/payment; modular services; status updates reach observers (demo may be sync notify).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Mentions concurrency and extensibility as first-class requirements, not afterthoughts.

probes: What do you assume about payment, cancel window, and when the delivery agent gets assigned?
Is a single order allowed to span multiple restaurants?

hints.1: Start by locking product rules before naming classes.
hints.2: Ask about assign timing, cancel states, payment scope, and one-restaurant-per-order.
hints.3: State: assign on READY_FOR_PICKUP, cancel only early states, payment often out of scope, one restaurant per order.

phases.goal: Name the multi-actor domain model with Order as the shared aggregate coordinating customer, restaurant, and agent.

must_hit.point: Identify three actors — Customer (browse/place), Restaurant (menu + prep status), DeliveryAgent (fulfill) — with Order as the shared aggregate; do not put assign logic in Restaurant or notify logic in Customer.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Draws Customer, Restaurant, DeliveryAgent, and Order as the hub coordinating them.

must_hit.point: Model Restaurant 1—1 Menu 1—* MenuItem (id, name, price, available); Order holds items List of OrderItem (menuItem, qty), status, optional deliveryAgent, and observers.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Sketches Menu/MenuItem and Order/OrderItem fields matching the research data model.

must_hit.point: Define OrderStatus enum path: PENDING, CONFIRMED, PREPARING, READY_FOR_PICKUP, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, plus CANCELLED.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Writes the full status enum including CANCELLED before coding transitions.

must_hit.point: Include Address/GeoPoint (lat, lon, distanceTo) and optional PaymentStrategy types (Card/UPI/Wallet) as supporting entities.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Shows geo helpers for Haversine assign/search and notes payment as optional extension.

probes: Who owns assignment vs notification vs menu — which object?
What states does an order move through from place to deliver?

hints.1: Think actors first, then the shared order object.
hints.2: Order coordinates actors; Restaurant owns menu; agents are assigned to orders.
hints.3: List Customer, Restaurant, DeliveryAgent, Order, OrderItem, MenuItem, OrderStatus, plus Address/GeoPoint.

phases.goal: Sketch Facade+Singleton service, Strategy interfaces, Observer on status, and FSM ownership before coding.

must_hit.point: FoodDeliveryService as Singleton/Facade holds ConcurrentHashMap catalogs and assignmentStrategy; exposes register*, searchRestaurants, placeOrder, updateOrderStatus, cancelOrder; private assignDelivery on READY_FOR_PICKUP.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Draws the facade with maps + strategy field and private assignDelivery triggered on ready.

must_hit.point: DeliveryAssignmentStrategy with NearestAvailableAgentStrategy (Haversine to restaurant); RestaurantSearchStrategy with SearchByCity / SearchByMenuKeyword / SearchByProximity.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Shows strategy interfaces and concrete nearest/search filter classes swappable without editing the facade.

must_hit.point: Order.setStatus validates transition then notifyObservers; OrderObserver implemented by Customer, Restaurant, DeliveryAgent — notifications not imported inside Order as SMSClient.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Separates status change + Observer fan-out from push/SMS clients.

must_hit.point: Architecture: Client → FoodDeliveryService → catalog maps, search strategies, Order FSM+Observer, DeliveryAssignmentStrategy; Order owns lifecycle+observers, service owns registries and when to assign.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Whiteboard matches the component breakdown without Redis/Kafka unless asked.

probes: Where do Strategy and Observer sit relative to FoodDeliveryService and Order?
What happens inside setStatus when status changes?

hints.1: Facade entry point plus pluggable search/assign.
hints.2: Order owns FSM and observers; service owns registries and assign timing.
hints.3: Name FoodDeliveryService, DeliveryAssignmentStrategy, RestaurantSearchStrategy, OrderObserver, and VALID transitions on Order.

phases.goal: Implement place → status FSM with allowed transitions, cancel rules, nearest assign, and Observer notify on the happy path.

must_hit.point: Enforce allowed Order FSM transitions (table/map); reject illegal jumps such as PREPARING → PENDING; typical path PENDING → CONFIRMED → PREPARING → READY_FOR_PICKUP → OUT_FOR_DELIVERY → DELIVERED (+ CANCELLED).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Shows a transition table/map and rejects illegal status updates.

must_hit.point: Cancel only while PENDING/CONFIRMED (before kitchen starts); after PREPARING, call out refund/policy rather than silent cancel.
must_hit.evidence_hint: cancelOrder checks early states and explains later cancel needs policy.

must_hit.point: On READY_FOR_PICKUP, findAgent via strategy (nearest available, Haversine), mark agent busy, then move to OUT_FOR_DELIVERY; release agent on deliver/cancel.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Implements assignDelivery private path tied to ready status with busy/release.

must_hit.point: Key APIs work end-to-end: placeOrder, updateOrderStatus, cancelOrder, searchRestaurants(strategies), getRestaurantMenu, register* — mandatory demo before pattern zoo.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Can run register + place + status + assign + deliver (+ cancel note) as the working demo.

probes: Walk me through placeOrder to DELIVERED including when assign runs.
Which cancel transitions do you allow?

hints.1: Code the happy path FSM before extra strategies.
hints.2: Validate transitions; assign on ready; notify observers on setStatus.
hints.3: PENDING→…→READY_FOR_PICKUP triggers nearest available agent → OUT_FOR_DELIVERY → DELIVERED; cancel only early.

phases.goal: Keep search, assignment, and optional payment swappable via Strategy (and optional Factory/CoR) without editing the facade.

must_hit.point: Swap DeliveryAssignmentStrategy for least-loaded / highest-rated / surge / VIP / batching without if-ladder inside FoodDeliveryService.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Says new strategy class for new policies; facade stays thin.

must_hit.point: Compose RestaurantSearchStrategy filters (city, menu keyword, proximity) — OCP for new filters; optional Chain of Responsibility framing for sequential filters.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Passes a list of filters / composed strategies to searchRestaurants.

must_hit.point: Optional PaymentStrategy.pay before confirming; failure must not advance FSM; idempotency on retries if payment in scope.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Wires payment strategy before CONFIRMED and mentions idempotent retries.

must_hit.point: Avoid god-class FoodDeliveryService that prices, pays, routes, and SMS — split SRP; optional Factory for payment/order adapters from type.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Keeps facade thin and delegates pricing/payment/notify/routing.

probes: How would you add surge or VIP assignment without touching the facade?
How do you add a new restaurant search filter?

hints.1: Anything policy-like should be a new Strategy.
hints.2: Assignment and search are injected; payment optional Strategy; avoid if-ladders.
hints.3: New DeliveryAssignmentStrategy / RestaurantSearchStrategy implementations; optional PaymentStrategy and Factory.

phases.goal: Make agent assign, status transitions, and catalog updates race-safe under concurrent orders.

must_hit.point: Two orders must not get the same agent: filter available, assign + setAvailable(false) under one critical section / CAS; loser retries or waits.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Describes atomic check-then-act on agent availability, not just ConcurrentHashMap puts.

must_hit.point: ConcurrentHashMap is fine for id→entity catalogs, but agent.available check-then-act still needs a lock / CAS; status transitions must be race-free.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Explicitly separates map thread-safety from assign/status critical sections.

must_hit.point: Menu item availability / restaurant capacity under concurrent place: atomic decrement or reject when over capacity; no agents → leave READY_FOR_PICKUP and retry/queue, never OUT_FOR_DELIVERY without an agent.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Handles stock/capacity races and empty-agent case without fake delivery status.

must_hit.point: Under dinner rush, avoid a global lock for all cities; lock per agent or CAS available; optionally shard agents by geo-cell.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Scales assign hot path with fine-grained locking rather than one global mutex.

probes: Two orders, one agent — what prevents double-assign?

hints.2: Wrap available check + mark busy in one critical section / CAS.
hints.3: Filter available, assign+setAvailable(false) atomically; ConcurrentHashMap alone is not enough for check-then-act.

tradeoffs.topic: Assign on placeOrder vs on READY_FOR_PICKUP
tradeoffs.strong_answer: Assign on placeOrder means the agent waits at the restaurant; assign on READY_FOR_PICKUP reduces idle time. State the product rule explicitly — awesome-LLD assigns on ready.

tradeoffs.topic: Linear Haversine scan vs geo index
tradeoffs.strong_answer: Haversine over all available agents is correct for LLD demos; production uses Redis GEO / quadtree for O(log n) radius queries (hq06 toolkit).

tradeoffs.topic: Enum FSM + transition map vs State pattern objects
tradeoffs.strong_answer: Enum + VALID_TRANSITIONS map ships fast and is interview-standard; full State classes only if behavior per state diverges heavily.
Tutorials use getInstance(); for tests you’d inject one FoodDeliveryService instance unless the interviewer wants classic Singleton.

gotchas.trap: Two orders race the same agent and both succeed.
gotchas.correction: Filter available, then assign + setAvailable(false) under one critical section / CAS; loser retries or waits.

gotchas.trap: Restaurant rejects after place with no clean path.
gotchas.correction: Transition to CANCELLED from PENDING/CONFIRMED, notify customer, trigger refund if payment was captured.

gotchas.trap: Customer cancels while PREPARING silently succeeds.
gotchas.correction: Usually deny or escalate to support/refund policy — do not allow silent cancel after kitchen starts.

gotchas.trap: No agents online but order marked OUT_FOR_DELIVERY.
gotchas.correction: Leave order in READY_FOR_PICKUP, retry/queue; never mark OUT_FOR_DELIVERY without an agent.

gotchas.trap: Assuming ConcurrentHashMap alone makes assign safe.
gotchas.correction: Fine for id→entity maps; agent availability check-then-act still needs explicit sync / CAS.

gotchas.trap: Adding surge / VIP / batching via if-ladder in the facade.
gotchas.correction: Introduce a new DeliveryAssignmentStrategy; do not grow the facade with conditionals.

gotchas.trap: Payment retries double-charge or advance FSM on failure.
gotchas.correction: PaymentStrategy.pay before confirming; use idempotency key on retries; on failure do not advance the FSM.

gotchas.trap: Live map tracking bolted onto every Order/menu read.
gotchas.correction: Separate location stream; Observer/WebSocket on location updates, not on every menu read.

gotchas.trap: God-class FoodDeliveryService that prices, pays, routes, and SMS.
gotchas.correction: Split by SRP — facade + strategies + observers — or design score is docked.

gotchas.trap: Finishing a Strategy zoo but missing the mandatory demo.
gotchas.correction: Ship place → status → assign → deliver first; patterns are secondary to the working path.
